author: fidjissimo
text: ChatGPT has me nailed. https://t.co/VqjW2VZOip

author: fidjissimo
text: OpenAI turns 10 today. As a newcomer, I wrote about my observations of the very special culture that’s been built here: https://t.co/Rci9OCLp1a

author: fidjissimo
text:
GPT-5.2 is here and it’s the best model out there for everyday professional work.

On GDPval, the thinking model beats or ties human experts on 70.9% of common professional tasks like spreadsheets, presentations, and document creation. It’s also better at general intelligence,

author: fidjissimo
text: We need the equivalent of the 20th-century clean water revolution, except for clean indoor air. People with post-infectious chronic illnesses have known for a while how insane it is that, as a society, we continue to find it perfectly acceptable to breathe air full of viruses

quoted.text: Researchers are uncovering the mysteries of why early-in-life acute infections can lead to neurodegenerative diseases in later years. https://t.co/jaQKVJWuYb

author: fidjissimo
text: You can now use ChatGPT with your friends! Group chats are now rolling out globally to Free, Go, Plus and Pro plans so you can make ChatGPT a multiplayer experience when you want. More on that here: https://t.co/f8tbEeDn32

author: fidjissimo
text:
Was fun talking to @WIRED about my first few months at @OpenAI and what I’m focused on. 
https://t.co/yIvVTsn6iX

author: fidjissimo
text:
GPT-5.1 is a great new model that we think people are going to like more than 5. But with 800M+ people using ChatGPT, one default personality won’t work for everyone. We launched new preset personalities so people can make ChatGPT their own. 
https://t.co/oYcRqKfYoF

author: fidjissimo
text: We’re very focused on making GPT-5 safer, and continue to make a lot of progress: https://t.co/t2XjuJQOOR

author: fidjissimo
text: We're shipping company knowledge for ChatGPT Business, Enterprise, and Edu: it brings all the context from your apps (Slack, Google Drive, GitHub, etc) together in ChatGPT so you can get answers that are specific to your business. https://t.co/zMJWM5pqpE

author: fidjissimo
text: ChatGPT Atlas is here! Our new browser has ChatGPT built in so it can help you across the web and, if you want, remember what you’ve done online and use that context for future requests. More of my thoughts on why we built this here: https://t.co/8Fnx6Stszc https://t.co/Tp1NGBH016

author: fidjissimo
text: I get asked all the time how we ship products so fast at @OpenAI despite a fairly small team. Now you know. We’ve got help - use Codex. https://t.co/QxGpszokMf

author: fidjissimo
text: Apps coming to ChatGPT is a big deal. There’s something really magical about having a conversation with apps to guide the actions you want to take. We can’t even imagine what devs will create with a capability like this. It will be fun to see.

author: fidjissimo
text: These numbers are 🤯

quoted.text: 4M Devs and 6B Tokens processed per minute .. @OpenAI https://t.co/wiK8sgMuqh

author: fidjissimo
text: Cool thing launching today: you can now buy products directly from ChatGPT (starting with Etsy and expanding soon to over a million Shopify merchants). It’s powered by the Agentic Commerce Protocol, an open standard we built with Stripe.  Merchants and developers who want Instant

author: fidjissimo
text: We’re beginning to roll out parental controls in ChatGPT, including the first-of-its-kind safety notification system to alert parents if their teen may be at risk of self-harm. Read more here: https://t.co/deJfP7WteZ

author: fidjissimo
text: AI should do more than just answer questions; it should anticipate your needs and help you reach your goals. That’s what we’re beginning to build, starting with ChatGPT Pulse (rolling out now to Pro, with goal of making it available to everyone over time): https://t.co/k17KPpg7Cj

author: fidjissimo
text:
We know that AI will create lots of new jobs, yet also create disruption. We’re announcing the OpenAI Jobs Platform to connect AI-ready workers with companies who need AI skills, and OpenAI-Certified for workers to learn and demonstrate their AI skills.

https://t.co/8afA8OilSP

author: fidjissimo
text: GPT-5 is here! And free for everyone to use. Such an important step in unlocking the power of AI for people everywhere. Congrats to the team!

quoted.text:
GPT-5 is here.

Rolling out to everyone starting today.

https://t.co/rOcZ8J2btI https://t.co/dk6zLTe04s

author: fidjissimo
text: I’ve always considered myself a pragmatic technologist — someone who loves technology not for its own sake, but for the direct impact it can have on people’s lives. That’s what makes this job so exciting, since I believe AI will unlock more opportunities for more people than any

author: fidjissimo
text:
I will officially start at OpenAI as CEO of Applications on August 18. I am sharing this essay on why I believe AI can be the greatest source of empowerment for all. 🧵
https://t.co/pvyDQPqtCy

author: fidjissimo
text:
Thanks @MichaBreakstone 🙏
Now let’s go cure diseases and make the world better; glad we’re all playing our part ❤️

quoted.text: @fidjissimo is the perfect combination of razor-sharp intellect, wholehearted compassion, unconquerable vision, and flawless integrity. A remarkable win for OpenAI—and for humanity—at the dawn of AGI.

author: fidjissimo
text:
Product + Research = ❤️
Can’t wait to work with @markchen90 and bring his breakthroughs to life through our products.

quoted.text: So excited to work with @fidjissimo - she's a product visionary!

author: fidjissimo
text: I worked with Kate for 10 years at Meta and the main word that comes to mind is “legend”. So happy to be reunited!

quoted.text: She’s all signal. No noise. Highest integrity leader I know. Very good news: for OpenAI, for all of us.

author: fidjissimo
text: I can hardly express how amazing it has been to see @gdb in action over the last year; working with him was a big part of why I decided to make this move. I couldn’t be more excited to work with him, @sama and the entire crew to deliver AGI.

quoted.text: Welcome @fidjissimo! Fidji has been an amazing friend and colleague, with unique insights and advice on OpenAI. I'm super excited to work with her to deliver AGI that benefits all of humanity.

author: fidjissimo
text:
So excited to be joining @openai and contributing to its mission. Thank you @sama for the opportunity- it will be such a privilege to work with such a talented team on one of the most important and ambitious endeavors in history. 
I’ll remain CEO of @Instacart for the next few

quoted.text:
so excited that @fidjissimo is joining openai in a new role: ceo of applications, reporting to me.

i'll remain ceo of openai, but in this new configuration i'll be able to increase my focus on research, compute, and safety.

these are critical as we approach superintelligence.
